title: agentic-forge plugin config
description: Plugin configuration (ADR 0041). The SAME schema validates two files: the user-level ~/.agentic-forge/config.json (cross-project, ADR 0049) and the per-repo <repo>/.agentic-forge/config.json. Precedence: built-in defaults < user-level < per-repo < env vars. All keys are optional; omitted keys fall back to built-in defaults. A committed example with every key lives at plugin/config.example.json (see docs/configuration.md). These files are COMMITTED — do not put secrets (API keys, tokens) in them; use env vars for those.

subagent_budget.description: Task-spawn caps; soft should be <= hard (soft warns, hard blocks).

external_reviewer.description: External reviewer CLI (increment 2). `command` is the executable name only (e.g. "codex") — not a shell line, and never an API key/secret (this file is committed).

command.description: A bare executable name on PATH (e.g. "codex") — not a path or shell line.

pr_watcher.description: PR watcher (ADR 0044/0045; autonomous mode 0063). Off by default; outward GitHub writes (push/reply/resolve/merge) are opt-in. Never force-pushes.

repos.description: owner/name repos the scheduled hourly job watches (empty = none).

auto_merge.description: Let the watcher merge a PR once the merge gate opens (ADR 0063). OFF by default — merging is irreversible and outward-facing.

merge_method.description: How auto_merge merges. Reaches argv as --<method>, so it is an enum here and clamped again in the library.

poll_seconds.description: Autonomous re-check cadence in seconds (default 600 = 10 min). This is ALSO the window an external PR reviewer gets: the gate cannot open before the first post-CI poll, so shortening it shortens that window.

auto_watch.description: Let the PR-created hook ENQUEUE a new PR for the scheduled watch (ADR 0068). OFF by default. Merging still requires auto_merge — watching without merging is the safe middle setting.

max_ticks.description: How many drains one queued PR may consume before it is dropped (default 144 = 24 h at the 10-minute cadence). Nothing is watched forever.
